note: The textbook case in this batch and the only core fit in it. Independent consultant advising senior leadership teams on culture and organisational development, billing $5,000-6,000 a day — 'successful, they own their own business... they make good money' almost word for word. Income is proven rather than asserted: $6,000 on peptides two months ago, a $20,000 vacation club, and an explicit statement that he understands and accepts the price. Health is not a crisis at any point — two fully recovered shoulder replacements, a manageable knee, blood work monitored, and body composition the only complaint. And the goal is unambiguously good-to-great: 6'0", 195 lb, training five days a week in his own gym, asking for a V-shape, a defined chest and a six pack. He is also the only prospect in the batch who bought. The clinical caveat is worth carrying forward alongside the earlier ICP observation: this perfect commercial fit has two prosthetic shoulders and a deferred knee surgery, so the stated ICP would have waved him straight through on every criterion it has and none of the ones that matter for a ballistic training programme.
